easy_fields.description: SeamlessAlign is a multimodal corpus of automatically aligned speech translations, totaling 470,000 hours. It was created using parallel data mining techniques, including an improved speech language identification model and a novel multimodal embedding space, to support massively multilingual and multimodal machine translation research.
